summary: Today's briefing highlights key legal judgments and regulatory changes impacting retail and investment sectors in India, alongside notable earnings reports.

bullets.text: Kerala High Court quashed a government order allowing POCSO prosecutors to handle non-POCSO cases.
Supreme Court declined to entertain a challenge to Section 163 BNSS related to recent Delhi protests.
Maharashtra FDA banned the sale of loose spices to combat adulteration in food products.
Flipkart Internet reported an 18% revenue increase to Rs 1,45,880 crore in FY26 as losses shrink.
Reliance Jio plans to launch a Rs 30,213 crore IPO featuring only new equity shares.
